decisions.reason: As a specialized marine niche with long qualification cycles and low catalog-carrying cost, it is still worth keeping the option open unless results clearly disappoint.
The 2019 LED replacement-kit extension suggests customer uptake and an installed base, so the product looks valuable enough to retain.
Because it was a relaunch of a previously popular design, uncertainty is relatively low and the firm is likely to continue harvesting a proven product.
By 2022 the firm likely has enough information on this newer office-lighting launch, and if demand is only moderate its overlap with the broader portfolio makes withdrawal the more rational option.
Although still somewhat uncertain, a differentiated premium pendant can justify staying on the market one more year because the upside remains plausible and the option value is not yet exhausted.
